//: Every external dependency, why we have it and where it may be used. Adding one needs Liam's approval. A package may use it when its name matches allowedIn (* matches any text) and its layer is in layers. cloudRuntime: true lets a library ship inside a cloud runtime bundle; only the user can approve one. See docs/guides/dependencies.md.

@biomejs/biome.reason: Formatter and linter in one fast tool.

@changesets/cli.reason: Versions and changelogs for what we ship, the CLI and the Studio app (D9).

@noble/hashes.reason: scrypt password hashing: independently audited, no dependencies, runs on every runtime. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10). Only the package that implements the PasswordHasher port uses it.
@noble/hashes.useInstead: the PasswordHasher port; for SHA-256 use the hashing port (WebCrypto)

@stryker-mutator/core.reason: Mutation testing: finds tests whose assertions were hollowed out. Runs nightly in CI only, report-only at first.

@stryker-mutator/vitest-runner.reason: Lets Stryker run each package's Vitest tests.

@tauri-apps/cli.reason: Tauri's command-line tool: generates the Android project and builds the shell (plan 7.2). Pinned to match the Rust tauri crate. Approved by Liam on HAL-1222.

@types/node.reason: Type definitions for Node, for Node packages, tests and tooling. The core's tsconfig loads no Node types.

@types/react-dom.reason: Type definitions for react-dom, which the kit's tests render with.

@typescript/typescript6.reason: The TypeScript parser API for tooling/check until TypeScript 7.1 ships its own API (D9). Remove then.

@vitest/coverage-v8.reason: Measures test coverage for the shared Vitest preset, which fails a package below the floor in its package.json. Vitest finds it as its own optional peer, so packages don't list it.

esbuild.reason: Bundles a sample integration against the packed integration kit, so check:bundle can prove the kit brings nothing into a cloud bundle (HAL-1216). Its metafile is what check:bundle reads. No dependencies beyond its own platform binaries. Tests only.

fast-check.reason: Property-based tests: generated and hostile inputs (deep nesting, huge files and lists, odd Unicode, Windows line endings, BOM) for the YAML layer, which reads other people's workspaces, and for how schema-kit uses Zod; generated cron expressions and times around daylight-saving changes for the routines scheduler; generated templates, scopes, amounts and durations for the workflow rules. Tests only. The shared Vitest preset in tooling-config imports it only to give every property a fixed seed.

jsdom.reason: A DOM for Vitest, so the kit's component tests check rendered markup, ARIA and clicks without a browser (HAL-175 section 13), and so the Android connect page's tests check its screens, focus and field errors (HAL-1140, approved by Liam on HAL-1253). Tests only.

react.reason: The Studio is one React codebase (docs/adr/2026-11-08-one-interface-codebase.md). No dependencies. Starts in the kit; the shell, features and apps/studio join when they render.

react-data-grid.reason: The table editor: cell editing, keyboard navigation and screen-reader support. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10).

react-dom.reason: Renders React in the webview and in the kit's tests. Its one dependency is React's own scheduler.

remark.reason: Parses Markdown, including model output, into a tree; our own view renders it without raw HTML. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10).

remark-gfm.reason: Tables, task lists, strikethrough and autolinks for remark. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10).

turbo.reason: Per-package tasks, --affected and the build cache (D9).

yaml.reason: Reads and writes YAML; the same library as the old app, so saved files come out the same. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10). No dependencies.

zod.reason: Validation and JSON Schema output. Approved by the user on 8 Nov 2026 (HAL-10). No dependencies. The one library allowed in cloud runtime bundles. Wrapped by schema-kit, so the rest of the code never sees Zod.
